title: MoRF-AST: Calibrated Probabilistic Virtual Sensing for Structural Monitoring under Changing Operating Conditions
abstract: arXiv:2608.24531v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Probabilistic full-field reconstruction provides uncertainty-aware response evidence for structural reliability assessment, yet inference from sparse and noisy measurements remains underdetermined. Most existing methods overlook shifts between offline training and operational distributions. Under such shifts, posterior intervals may become miscalibrated, causing the reported uncertainty to lose its probabilistic meaning. This study proposes Modal Residual Flow Matching with Context-Conditioned Affine Spread Transport (MoRF-AST) for calibrated structural virtual sensing under changing operating conditions. MoRF constructs an analytic Gaussian reference posterior in normalized modal coordinates and trains a conditional flow only on posterior-whitened residuals. translated_title: MoRF-AST：变化运行条件下结构监测的校准概率虚拟传感
translated_abstract: 概率全场重建为结构可靠性评估提供了具有不确定性意识的响应证据，然而从稀疏且含噪声的测量中进行推断仍存在欠定问题。大多数现有方法忽视了离线训练与运行分布之间的偏移。在这种偏移下，后验区间可能变得失准，导致所报告的不确定性失去其概率意义。本研究提出模态残差流匹配与上下文条件仿射扩散传输（MoRF-AST），用于变化运行条件下的校准结构虚拟传感。MoRF在归一化模态坐标中构建解析高斯参考后验，并仅在后验白化残差上训练条件流。在部署时，AST根据已安装传感器的历史测量估计响应尺度，并使用门控、保均值的Bures-Wasserstein传输来调整后验扩散。
tldr: 本文提出MoRF-AST方法，通过模态残差流匹配和上下文条件仿射扩散传输，在变化运行条件下实现校准的结构虚拟传感，解决了传统方法在后验区间失准的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MoRF-AST, which uses modal residual flow matching with context-conditioned affine spread transport to achieve calibrated structural virtual sensing under changing operating conditions, addressing the miscalibration of posterior intervals in existing methods.
